plan.cost: Expected ~$0.20 pilot and ~$0.80 full (uncached prices). Judge <= $0.20.
diagnostics_not_gates: grade-2 papers promoted from ranks 11-20 into the top10
plan.headroom_offline: Perfect top20 reorder of Decision46: 0.946 nDCG@10 vs 0.768 (98 of 143 buried grade-2 papers are at ranks 11-20).
plan.hypothesis: A focused 0-10 re-score of the reranked top20 separates direct answers from related work better than the 50-paper 0-4 pass.
plan.labels: shared-labels/labels-d46.json plus a child layer of judge-graded top10 fills (frozen judge; the 100 reference overrides, legacy name human, preserved).
plan.multiple_comparisons: Two systems from the same responses; a secondary-only qualifier is reported as such and needs a fresh confirmation before promotion.
plan.one_change: Second stage over the Decision46 top20: two 0-10 passes averaged; sort, ties keep Decision46 order; RRF c=30 with Decision46 order (primary).

pilot_gate.note: The pilot queries informed earlier designs and the loss analysis saw all 100 dev queries, so the gate is a sanity screen, not evidence.

qualifies_if.consistency: nDCG delta vs reference > 0 on both pilot20 and new80
qualifies_if.ndcg@10_delta_vs_reference: > 0.0106 (conservative single-pass MDD of the safeguard; two-pass noise unmeasured) with paired 95% CI lower bound > 0

stages.full: Other 80 dev queries: 160 requests; only if the pilot gate passed and the user approved.
